mechanism: Colder lower-troposphere USA48 satellite temperatures proxy surface cold, driving residential space-heating natural gas demand; economic target is reported later.
predictor: UAH version 6.1 lower-troposphere USA48 monthly temperature anomaly, satellite MSU/AMSU record
outcome: EIA monthly U.S. natural gas delivered to residential consumers, million cubic feet, divided by days in month to reduce month-length artefacts
season: October through March only; calendar target months January 2000 through December 2025 inclusive
forecast_issue: 15th day of month immediately after target month, a delayed-release economic nowcast, not a future-weather forecast
availability: UAH and ground HDD assumed available by month-end plus14days. EIA labels assumed available at end of second month after target month. Both current archives, not historical release-vintage proof.

models.baseline: Separate calendar-month OLS: intercept, linear year trend centered at target year, previous-year same-month residential gas/day
models.satellite: Identical baseline plus current-month UAH USA48 anomaly
models.ground_hdd: Identical baseline plus current-month official national ground heating degree days/day
models.ground_hdd_satellite: Identical ground-HDD model plus current-month UAH USA48 anomaly

training: Exactly previous 10 years of the same calendar month, all labels before issue; missing required source/target/prior gas abstains; no future targets, no tuning or clipping
evaluation: RMSE and MAE on identical complete months; evaluate direct satellite vs baseline and incremental combined vs ground-HDD
uncertainty: Paired circular two-winter-year block bootstrap,10000draws,seed20260927. Winteryear=y+1 forOct-Dec else y; boundarywinters mayhave3months; samplewholewinterblocks.
gate: At least5% RMSE reduction, lowerMAE, and strictlypositive95%RMSE-reductioninterval forboth satellite vsbaseline AND ground_hdd_satellite vsground_hdd. MissingHDD meansnoincrementalusefulnessverification.
planned_sensitivity: Separately summarize calendar2021-2025, when all10 trainingyears followAug2010 EIAcollectionchange; descriptiveonly, noselection or newgate.
claim_limits: Current-vintage rolling retrospective nowcast; nohistoricalpoint-in-time certification
